body.message:
We can commence the contract from today for a 30-day term, with the option to extend thereafter.

At the moment, we have both Burj view and non-Burj view options available.

The rate for the non-Burj view unit is AED 4,500, while the Burj view unit is AED 5,000.

Please note that these rates are fixed for the next three months.
